description: Security gate: scan code before shipping commands (git commit, push, PR)

hooks.command: $s = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_commit_scan.py"; $c = @(); foreach ($n in 'py', 'python', 'python3') { $c += @(Get-Command $n -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object Source) }; foreach ($p in $c) { $a = @(); if ((Split-Path $p -Leaf) -like 'py.exe') { $a = @('-3') }; & $p @a -c 0 *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $input | & $p @a $s --stdout-json; exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('armis-appsec: no working py/python/python3 on PATH; hook not run, commit gate is OFF.'); exit 1
